detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to excessive CPU temperatures (up to 90°C) during gaming
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Verify that the "Maximum processor state" setting is not causing any issues.
Try using a different power plan or adjusting the power settings manually to see if it resolves the issue.
Consider using a third-party software to monitor CPU temperatures and adjust settings accordingly.
